articles.title: Hickory Ridge Gets $12,000 for Streetlight Upgrade
articles.deck: The money will be spent over the next year, with the first work starting in June.
body: The group has raised $12,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food. Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Tuesday mornings.

articles.title: Council Splits 4–3 on Pet Adoption Fair
articles.deck: The vote came after 9 residents spoke at Sunday’s session.
body: Residents of Foxglove Heights said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street. Councilmember Joseph Gilroy asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $1,200.

The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Public works estimates the work will take about 9 weeks once it starts in September.

body: The event will be held at the Cedar Hollow Pavilion, rain or shine, with a backup date set for the following Thursday.

articles.title: Letter: the Canal Park Food Pantry Did a Good Job This Fall
body: To the editor: I have lived on Eaton Street for 25 years, and I want to say what a difference the Canal Park Food Pantry has made.
Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Eaton Street use it every week.
Mateo Fairbanks, Mill Hill

articles.title: Cyrus Hartigan, 62, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Cyrus Hartigan for the many years of service to Cedar Hollow.
body: Cyrus Hartigan died in June at home on Wren Lane, at the age of 62. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group in his or her name.

Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Cyrus Hartigan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Cedar Hollow.
